project.title: CIWARS - Wastewater Based Surveillance of AMR in Two VA Communities
project.description: Here are samples associated with CIWARS, NSF project 200475124-hr flow proportional composite samples were taken twice weekly from one wastewater treatment plant for a year.24-hr flow proportional composite samples were taken from a second plant once a week for about 3 months.The purpose of this study was to investigate antibiotic resistance in wastewater and gain insight into the potential for wastewater based surveillance for AMR.
